Parking and Traffic Commission
  City of Inglewood City Hall Community Room A
  One West Manchester Blvd.Inglewood, CA 90301

  OCTOBER 2019 MEETING MINUTES

Commissioners  Staff Members
Michael Benbow, Chairperson  Peter Puglese, TE, PE, City Traffic Engineer
Charles Braggs, District 1  Raquel Méndez, Associate Engineer (Transportation)
Leonel Garcia, District 2  Mario Inga, Parking & Enterprise Service Manager
Brett C.S. Roberts, District 3  Diana Maximo, Serco Manager
Barbara Brooks, District 4  Lieutenant Cardell Hurt, Traffic Unit Commander

1. Roll Call
   A meeting of the Parking and Traffic Commission was held at City of Inglewood located on the 9th Floor on October
  23rd, 2019, at 19:00. All Commissioners and City Staff attended.

2. Approval of Minutes for September 25, 2019
   Motion to accept the meeting minutes was made by Commissioner Leonel Garcia. Seconded by Commissioner
  Charles Braggs. Meeting minutes approval 5-0 from Commissioners

3. Public Comments
  Some of the issues that residents consulted the Commission were the following.
   Resident is asking for support to provide better street parking condition. For example, Metro users and non-residents
  are using Lemoli Avenue as a parking spot. This has prevented the street from being cleaned during the street cleaning
  day. Commissioners recommended the resients to contact the parking enforcement at is (310) 412-5590. In addition,
  Public Works Department took some of the residents’ concerns to investigate and find a solution.

4. Unfinished Business
   None

5. New Business
   None

6. Public Hearing
   None

7. Resolution
   None

8. Referral from City Council/City Department
   None

9. Parking and Traffic Control
   None

10. Police Department
   None

11. Commissioner Initiatives
   Commissioner Leonel Garcia inquired about La Tijera Boulevard and Fairview Boulevard intersection. Mr. Garcia
  is getting comments from the residents and would like an update from Public Works (PW) Department. City Traffic
  Engineer presented various options that the City had analyzed. However, the intersection recently was modified as
  part of a safe route to school project.
